actions.definition: one of four group indices and one of four declared strengths

decoder: one shared polynomial-strength action-conditioned affine model: s B_g[1,standardized_code]+s(1−s) G_g[1,standardized_code]
encoders: reuse original native8/native12/PCA8 and nonlinear random8; shallow random8 uses32 fixed Gaussian candidates with original retrospective discovery selection, explicitly a new exploratory baseline; current-output box quantizer uses width/2^b<=1
fitting: discovery-fit only; standardization on discovery-fit codes; ridge grid1e-6,1e-4,.01,.1,1 chosen on original separate discovery-validation; no selection from current test outcomes
inference: no population/pristine holdout claim, no semantic or generality claim
models: reuse shallow17/29/43 and nonlinear117/129/143; no neural retraining
policy: at strength3/4 choose group maximizing drop in original top-vs-runner-up margin; ordered top/runner labels provided as7extra context bits; no exact baseline margin supplied; descriptive same-code and same-class-pair witness search
precision_control: reuse previously selected native-coordinate bit allocation; simulate action only on midpoint reconstruction, never on unavailable true state; fixed original downstream computation charged
projection_warning: current-output quantizer already computes nominated current readout; its cost and inability to see future state are explicit
report_timing: T(h) computed from original state once; T(hprime) never provided
status: post-test exploratory reuse; prospective means prediction before the action, not preregistration; existing test images and previous outcomes already inspected
